tasks.title: Define the vacancy shape, the search input type, the clock and the repost fingerprint
tasks.dod: The fingerprint and vacancy-schema unit tests pass (case, spacing, separator collision, empty parts) and the three planned libraries are installed with the build green.

tasks.title: Implement the date and salary filters and their tags as pure rules
tasks.dod: Unit tests for the date and salary verdicts pass for overlap, single figure, open bounds, currency/period mismatch, rough and missing dates, and the four tags.

tasks.title: Define the disposition set, the run result and the accounting check
tasks.dod: Unit tests show every read vacancy is counted in exactly one bucket in the AC-10 order, the buckets add up to the read count, and a mismatch is detected.

tasks.title: Define the three seam interfaces with their typed failures, the test fakes, and fix the fail-loudly wording
tasks.dod: The three seam interfaces and the test fakes compile and a fake-clock/fake-judge test passes; the CLAUDE.md fail-loudly sentence matches ADR 0002.

tasks.title: Promote the staged shown_vacancy migration into the live migrations
tasks.dod: Migration 0002 applies and reverts cleanly (user_version 1→2→1), the table constraints reject empty values and duplicate keys, and the updated migrate tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement the SQLite seen-store and the opener that creates or refuses the database
tasks.dod: Seen-store tests pass against real SQLite: identity and fingerprint lookups, idempotent one-transaction marking, and an unusable or missing-folder database is reported instead of silently recreated.

tasks.title: Build the shared polite HTTP client: pace, back-off and typed refusals
tasks.dod: Fake-clock tests prove at most one request per second per client, at most 3 retries within 60 s of back-off, a throttled stop afterwards, and no fetch after a stop.

tasks.title: Implement the Claude fit judge: rubric prompt, schema-checked answer, failure classes
tasks.dod: Tests with a fake SDK client cover a valid answer, the instruction flag, an unusable answer and each service-error mapping, with one call per vacancy and no CV or key in any failure detail.

tasks.title: Save real public LinkedIn pages as fixtures and record what they show
tasks.dod: Real public LinkedIn pages are saved in test/fixtures/linkedin/ with a README answering each sub-question of spec §8 open question 1, and the fixture inventory test passes.

tasks.title: Parse LinkedIn results pages into cards and list them with typed stops
tasks.dod: Tests over the saved LinkedIn fixtures pass for card parsing, rough-age ranges, the expected count and the blocked, failed and empty stops, with no sign-in path.

tasks.title: Parse LinkedIn detail pages, assemble the LinkedIn source and register it
tasks.dod: Tests over the saved detail fixtures pass for description, pay, the cut-off sign and the blocked and unreadable stops, and the LinkedIn source is registered behind the VacancySource seam.

tasks.title: Classify cards: drop, skip seen and reposts, and order the candidates
tasks.dod: Tests pass for the AC-10 check order, seen versus repost, same-search siblings, show-everything marks and both candidate orderings.

tasks.title: Implement runSearch: list, classify, hydrate and judge under the limit, present, mark seen
tasks.dod: Offline runSearch tests pass for the happy path: at most the judging limit of judge calls, leftovers reported as limit and not marked seen, and vacancies marked seen only after the result is presented.

tasks.title: Handle source stops and partial reads in runSearch
tasks.dod: Tests through runSearch cover blocked, failed and empty at listing, throttled mid-hydration and the partial-read boundary; every stop kind reaches the result and fails the run, and a partial read does not.

tasks.title: Handle judge failures, unexpected errors, an unusable memory and a failed print in runSearch
tasks.dod: Tests through runSearch cover an unusable answer, each service-level judge failure, an unexpected exception, an unusable store, a failing presenter and the accounting check, with no CV or key in any failure message.

tasks.title: Render the fit-sorted vacancy list with its tags and marks
tasks.dod: Tests pass for two-group fit ordering with stable ties, all tags and marks shown, the partial-description and instruction suffixes, and a low-fit vacancy still listed.

tasks.title: Render the coverage report, the loud warnings and the whole result document
tasks.dod: Golden tests reproduce the CLI contract's example outputs; every failure mode ends with a coverage report whose buckets add up to Read and a RUN FAILED line, and a partial read warns without failing.

tasks.title: Implement preflight: argument parsing, input validation, CV, key and the contact notice
tasks.dod: Tests cover every usage-error code, several problems reported together, the CV format and emptiness rules, the missing key, and a contact notice that never prints the matched text.

tasks.title: Wire the adapters in src/cli.ts and set the output streams and exit status
tasks.dod: main() tests pass for exit statuses 0, 1 and 2 and stdout/stderr separation, the smoke tests still pass against dist/cli.js, and the concrete adapters are wired only in src/cli.ts.

tasks.title: Add the cross-cutting offline acceptance tests for the quality scenarios
tasks.dod: Offline end-to-end tests pass for every failure mode ending in a summing coverage report, zero repeat listings across runs, judge calls within the limit, and no CV or key text in any output.
